svg.text: The stop condition is not "the agent said it is done": it is the next scan finding nothing from the previous list, with coverage_complete still true. A scanner that stopped running between rounds breaks both, and

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shows up in scanners_skipped instead of turning into zero findings.
